articles.title: Police in Philippines pursue three charges against Thomas Markle Sr over child sex abuse images
articles.summary: Filipino police are pursuing three charges against Thomas Markle Sr relating to child sexual abuse images, Sky News understands.

articles.title: Prague train crash leaves 46 people injured
articles.summary: Two trains have collided into each other near the main railway station in Prague, injuring 46 people.

articles.title: Three Melbourne Cup trophies worth £500k each stolen
articles.summary: Police are searching for three Melbourne Cup trophies collectively worth more than £1.5m after they were stolen from a display cabinet at a racecourse in Melbourne.

articles.title: US to further curb China's access to Nvidia chips
articles.summary: The US government is set to further restrict China's access to the most powerful AI chips, such as the ones provided by tech giant Nvidia.
